description: Ranks customers by total revenue within a date range. Use for any 'biggest / best / top customers' style question.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many customers to return, capped server-side at 100

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: to
params.description: End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD

example_questions: who are our biggest customers this year
which accounts bring in the most money
rank customers by revenue for Q2
show me our best customers last month
sab se baray customers kaun hain
hamara sab se bara client kaun hai revenue ke hisaab se
graphql: query TopCustomers($limit: Int, $from: Date!, $to: Date!, $orderBy: CustomerOrder) { topCustomers(limit: $limit, from: $from, to: $to, orderBy: $orderBy) { name totalRevenue orderCount } }
returns: List of customer names with summed revenue and order count for the period, highest first.
do_not_use_when: The user names one specific customer — use customerDetail instead. The user asks about revenue over time rather than a ranking — use revenueByPeriod.
notes: If the user says 'this year' resolve to Jan 1 of the current year through today. 'Last quarter' means the previous complete calendar quarter.
